  refine ⟨finalState unitOps (fun _ _ => ()) (fun _ => some ()), ?_, ?_⟩
  · rfl
  · rfl","segment_equivalence":"by
  intro input outside
  refine ⟨finalState ops input outside, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rfl
  · have htrace : (finalState ops input outside).trace = traceData := by
      simp [finalState]
      rfl
    rw [htrace]
    rfl
  · have htrace : (finalState ops input outside).trace = traceData := by
      simp [finalState]
      rfl
    have hmem : ∀ (b i : Nat), (finalState ops input outside).memory
        ⟨.global, 0, 3, i⟩ = some (input 3 i) := by
      intro b i; cases i <;> simp [finalState, initial, layout] <;> rfl
    have hrun : runLaunch ops layout geometry fuel program
        (initial layout input outside) = some (finalState ops input outside) := rfl
    simp [extract, layout, hrun, finalState]
    refine List.mapM_congr ?_ |>.trans (by
      simp [hmem]
      exact rfl)
    intro p
    cases p with
    | mk b i =>
      simp [hmem]
      exact rfl"}}
